workshop.whereLabel: Where to find it once installed

where.selectionButton: The toolbar that appears when you select text in notes

workshop.risk: It runs together with DeepStudent and can do what the app itself can do. Before installing, the workshop checked that it installs and uninstalls cleanly. If something feels off, turn it off or uninstall it at any time.
workshop.installed: Installed and ready to use; it also loads automatically after a restart.
workshop.disabled: Turned off. Turn it on again when you need it.
workshop.undone: Uninstalled. The versions you made stay in the workshop and can be restored at any time.
workshop.cancelled: Dropped. Ask the AI any time if you want it after all.
workshop.restored: Back on the last version that worked. Data it already saved is not undone.
workshop.restoreFailed: Could not go back to the previous version. Check its state in the plugin manager.
workshop.notRecovered: It did not take effect, and a working state is not confirmed yet. Check the plugin manager.
workshop.notFound: This work can no longer be found. Check Workshop history in the plugin manager.
workshop.creationsDescription: Works waiting for you or being built show up here, and uninstalled ones can be restored here without building them again. Installed works are in “My plugins” above.
workshop.creationsEmpty: Nothing yet. Pick an opener under “Make a new one” to start.

errors.interrupted: Building was interrupted (the app was closed). Press Continue to pick it up.
errors.notActive: The new version could not start; the previous version is still in use. Let the AI look at what went wrong.
errors.sealed: The AI’s code used something this kind of plugin may not use: it can only go online and use the model in declared ways. Let the AI fix it to follow the rules.
errors.invalid: The AI’s code did not pass the check. Let the AI keep fixing it.
errors.conflict: This card was updated in the meantime. Refresh and confirm again.
errors.state: This step is not possible right now; its state has changed. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.generationUnavailable: The chat service is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.safeMode: Workshop works cannot run or install in safe mode. Restart the app normally and try again.
errors.readOnly: Installing is not possible right now: plugin settings are read-only.
errors.servicesUnavailable: App features it needs are not loaded, so the check could not finish. Try again later.
errors.notFound: This work can no longer be found; it may have been deleted.
errors.otherConversation: This work belongs to another conversation. Continue there, or use “Change with AI” in the plugin manager.
errors.crashed: “{{name}}” went wrong too many times, so it has been turned off. Your notes and materials are not affected.
errors.activationFailed: “{{name}}” could not start, so it has been turned off. Your notes and materials are not affected.
errors.noPrevious: This work has no previous version yet.
errors.onlyManaged: Only works made in the Plugin Workshop can be changed here.
errors.skillMissing: The Plugin Workshop is not ready yet. Try again shortly; the new conversation has been kept.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong and it could not finish.
errors.linkUnreadable: This address does not return a calendar. Check that it is the full https:// subscription link (often ending in .ics), then press “Fixed it, try again”.
errors.settingMissing: Something still needs to be filled in first.
errors.settingInvalid: This address cannot be used: it must be a full address starting with https://, without a port or user name.
errors.openTimeout: It is installed, but its screen has not appeared yet. Wait a moment and press Open again.
errors.notStarted: Press “Start building” on the card first.
errors.incompatible: "{{name}}" was made for another version of the app and cannot run here. Remake it for this version; it will do the same.
errors.servicesDisabled: It needs "{{services}}", which is turned off. Turn on "{{services}}" in the plugin manager and try again.
errors.truncated: There was too much to write at once and the AI's answer was cut off. Let the AI continue, or try a minimal version.
errors.secret: Something that looks like a key showed up in the plan or the code and was blocked. Keys go in the password field on the card and never into the plugin. Ask the AI to fix it.

workshop.repairPrompt: “{{name}}” has a problem. Please fix it.
workshop.startConsent: Pressing “Start building” lets the AI write the code from the plan above and load and unload it once in the app to check it. Nothing is installed yet; you decide that when it is ready.
workshop.agentEditing: The AI is changing the code based on the check. It will wait here for you when done.
